description: This file defines the ArtifactClient class for interacting with the AWS Artifact service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It declares methods for various AWS Artifact operations, including retrieving account settings, reports, and customer agreements, with both synchronous and asynchronous variants.

classes.name: ArtifactClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Artifact service via AWS SDK for PHP. It extends AwsClient and provides method annotations for AWS Artifact API operations.

methods.name: getAccountSettings
methods.description: Retrieves the account settings from AWS Artifact.

methods.name: getAccountSettingsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the account settings from AWS Artifact.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches a report from AWS Artifact.

methods.name: getReportAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a report from AWS Artifact.

methods.name: getReportMetadata
methods.description: Fetches metadata associated with a report.

methods.name: getTermForReport
methods.description: Retrieves terms associated with a report.

methods.name: getTermForReportAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves terms for a report.

methods.name: listReports
methods.description: Lists reports available in AWS Artifact.

methods.name: putAccountSettingsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates or sets account settings.
